```artifact
Feature: User Experience and System Performance for Consultation Requests

  Background:
    Given the system is installed and running
    And the user has no computer background

  Scenario: People with no computer background should be able to use the system relatively easily
    When the user accesses the system for the first time
    Then the system should provide clear and simple instructions for navigation
    And the user should be able to complete a Consultation Request without assistance

  Scenario: The system should be designed to keep the system navigation very simple and intuitive
    When the user navigates through the system
    Then the system should have a straightforward layout with minimal steps to complete a task
    And the system should provide clear labels and tooltips for all interactive elements

  Scenario Outline: A normal Consultation Request should get filled in less than 5 minutes
    Given the user starts filling out a Consultation Request
    When the user completes the form with <data>
    Then the time taken to fill out the form should be less than 5 minutes

    Examples:
      | data                          |
      | minimal relevant information  |
      | edge case information         |
      | invalid information           |

  Scenario: Installation Guide shall be prepared
    When the user accesses the Installation Guide
    Then the guide should provide step-by-step instructions for installing the system
    And the guide should be easy to understand and follow

  Scenario: User Manual for end users shall be prepared
    When the user accesses the User Manual
    Then the manual should provide clear instructions for using the system
    And the manual should cover all necessary features and functionalities
```
